class.name: IfcStructuralAction
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: A structural action is a structural activity that acts upon a structural item or building element. HISTORY New entity in IFC 2x2. IFC 2x4 change: Attribute DestabilizingLoad made optional. Attribute CausedBy deleted; use IfcRelAssignsToProduct via ReferencedBy instead. Structural actions are grouped into either an IfcStructuralLoadGroup of predefined type LOAD_GROUP or, more o

members.member: Indicates if this action may cause a stability problem. If it is 'FALSE', no further investigations regarding stability problems are necessary. A bool, or null when unset.
Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
